2 — does things together with the people next door?
4 — lives next to people who can be noisy?
5 — was surprised the first time they saw their neighbours?
7 — lives next to people who once damaged their property?
8 — says their problems with their neighbours were avoidable?

11 — had legal problems with the neighbours?

r1.exp: 1=F (Francis: 'apparently, they've both RETIRED'). 2=E (Ella: 'shared birthday, celebrated JOINTLY IN THE GARDEN'). 3=A (Alice: 'always there if i need to BORROW some sugar or milk and vice versa'). 4=B (Brian: 'sometimes I have to ask them to TURN THE STEREO DOWN'). 5=F (Francis: 'Imagine how AMAZED WE WERE when we discovered there was a couple living there'). 6=C (Conrad: 'part of the problem is their PETS'). 7=A (Alice: 'they left the taps running and FLOODED their bathroom. The water RUINED OUR WALLS'). 8=D (Doris: 'if only they had SPOKEN TO US ABOUT IT BEFOREHAND'). 9=C (Conrad: 'made an awful MESS in the yard'). 10=B (Brian: 'they're always RESPECTFUL'). 11=D (Doris: 'We had to go to COURT to settle everything'). 12=E (Ella: 'they also HELP US FIX THINGS IN THE HOUSE').

r13.exp: 'We just thought it would be A LAUGH TO TRY OURSELVES' = htjeli su se zabaviti = B.

r14.exp: 'Didn't matter WHO YOU WERE, because you could START A BAND TOO' = glazba pokazuje da to može svako = B.

r15.exp: 'We weren't going to stand for CENSORSHIP' = odbijali su da im govore što smiju pjevati = D.

r16.exp: 'We knew they would TWIST AND DISTORT EVERYTHING WE SAID' = novinari ne bi govorili istinu = A.

r17.exp: 'You can't RAISE KIDS when you're constantly touring' = morali brinuti o obiteljima = A.

r18.exp: 'Before, nobody was vegetarian and no one protested. Nowadays many more people like that. We PLAYED A ROLE IN THAT' = pomogli promijeniti stavove = C.

r19.exp: 'Grammar looked like a mysterious formula. (19)____. Teachers today tend to agree.' → F: TWELVE YEARS LATER I HAD A DEGREE IN FRENCH, BUT WAS CONVINCED THAT THERE MUST BE A BETTER WAY.

r20.exp: 'Teach students how to achieve simple tasks and express everyday feelings. (20)____. Emphasis on INTERACTING.' → B: As a result, BEGINNERS ARE MORE LIKELY TO LEARN HOW TO BUY A TRAIN TICKET THAN HOW TO FORM THE PLURAL OF A VERB.

r21.exp: 'Before, people had to struggle in a traditional classroom. (21)____. For example, the BBC's book Discovering Portuguese.' → A: HOWEVER, TODAY'S STUDENTS ARE LUCKY TO HAVE A WIDE VARIETY OF MULTI-MEDIA PROGRAMMES TO HELP THEM.

r22.exp: 'Self-study courses provide easy and cheap way. (22)____. But teachers do have a point.' → E: THE BEST OF THEM HAVE PLENTY OF QUICK, SIMPLE EXERCISES, PHOTOGRAPHS AND REAL LIFE RECORDINGS SO THAT YOU CAN LEARN A LANGUAGE ON YOUR OWN.

r23.exp: 'Without someone there, you won't make much progress. (23)____. The school I attended in London pioneered the communicative method.' → H: THAT IS WHY, WHEN I TOOK UP SPANISH, I DECIDED TO GO BACK INTO THE NEW COMMUNICATIVE LANGUAGE CLASSROOM.

r24.exp: 'Diet of role-play and exercises. (24)____. You HAVE TO TELL the other students what you really think, want and feel.' → C: THE BEST THING ABOUT LEARNING IN A SMALL GROUP IS THAT IT MOTIVATES YOU TO USE THE LANGUAGE YOU ARE LEARNING.

r25.exp: 'About A QUARTER of the world' — neodređeni član 'a' uz količinski izraz.

r26.exp: 'THERE is a perfectly good reason' — egzistencijalna rečenica: there is = postoji razlog.

r27.exp: 'Because it WAS the sensible option' — past simple za prošle navike/stanja.

r28.exp: 'Passed ON each other's right' — prijedlog 'on' za stranu: on the right side.

r29.exp: 'To ENSURE that your sword arm was between yourself and him' — 'ensure' = osigurati, pobrinuti se (za nešto objektivno).

r30.exp: 'Overturned this practice AS PART of its new social order' — 'as part of' = kao dio.

r31.exp: 'Anxious to BREAK OFF all remaining links' — frazalni glagol: break off = prekinuti (veze).

r32.exp: 'If you wanted a cheap vehicle, you BOUGHT American' — second conditional u prošlom obliku (if + past → past simple).

r33.exp: 'ACCORDING to a popular legend' — fiksni prijedložni izraz: according to = prema.

r34.exp: 'Many of WHICH are still used today' — relativna zamjenica 'which' s prijedlogom 'of'.

r35.exp: 'The first game TOOK place a year later' — fiksna kolokacija: take place = odvijati se, dogoditi se.

r36.exp: 'Lost TO New York Base Ball Club' — prijedlog 'to' uz glagol 'lose': lose to = izgubiti od.

r37.exp: 'The league supported ITSELF by charging a small admission fee' — povratna zamjenica: support itself = uzdržavati se.

r38.exp: 'More people than EVER before' — fiksni izraz: more than ever before = više nego ikad.

r39.exp: 'The league grew and so DID the expenses' — eliptična konstrukcija: so + auxiliary = i troškovi su rasli.

r40.exp: 'There was NO way they could compete' — 'no' za negaciju imenice (nema načina).

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA ograničenja: jednakost, disciplina, smanjenje socijalnih razlika, fokus na učenje. PROTIV: sloboda izražavanja, kreativnost, individualni identitet. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (školska odjeća). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi. Napomena: travanjski rok — nema ispita slušanja.
